title: Put us on your home screen
subtitle: The app opens full screen with one tap, like any app. No store, nothing to download, always up to date.
installedToast: Installed. You'll find it on your home screen.
installedText: All set. Open it any time from your home screen.
ios: In Safari, tap ⋯ at the bottom right.
Tap “View More”, then “Add to Home Screen”.
Leave “Open as Web App” on and tap “Add”.
Open Nails by Alynna from your Home Screen, like any app.
iosAlt: Safari's bottom bar with the ⋯ button circled at the right.
The share options with “Add to Home Screen” circled.
The “Add to Home Screen” screen: “Open as Web App” is on and “Add” is circled.
The Nails by Alynna icon on the Home Screen, circled.
iosToolbar: Is the Share button right in Safari's toolbar (or are you on an iPad)? Tap it and carry on from step 3.
iosChrome: Chrome on iPhone: tap Share on the right of the address bar, then “Add to Home Screen” and “Add”.
androidManual: In Chrome, tap ⋮ at the top right, then “Install and create shortcut”.
Open Nails by Alynna from your home screen or app list.
androidAlt: Chrome with the ⋮ button circled and its menu open at “Install and create shortcut”.
The “Install and create shortcut” panel with “Install” circled.
The install window for Nails by Alynna with its “Install” button circled.
A phone home screen with the Nails by Alynna icon circled.
androidOther: Not there? Look for “Install app” or “Add to Home screen” in the browser's menu.
inApp: You're inside {{app}}'s built-in browser, which can't add apps. Open this page in Safari or Chrome: tap ⋯ and choose “Open in browser”, or copy the link.
qrText: Point your phone's camera at the code to open this page there, then follow the steps.
desktopManual: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
desktopMenu: No icon? In Chrome: ⋮ → “Cast, save, and share” → “Install page as app”. In Safari on a Mac: Share → “Add to Dock”.
desktopAlt: A browser address bar with the install icon circled at its right end.
